thread:
maria_sales: Quick alert — Quantum Pharma put the POC on hold. Legal and IT flagged SSO + egress IPs + DPA. Need exec-level unblock. :exclamation:
julian_se: Details? which SSO? Okta / SAML?
maria_sales: Okta SAML. They want in-scope SSO assertion attributes plus IdP-initiated flow. Also they can't route traffic through our hosted endpoints due to egress policy — asking for static IP ranges / IPsec peering.
tara_engineering: We support SP-initiated SAML currently. IdP-initiated requires small change (session redirect). ETA 3 business days to enable toggle.
noah_infra: For egress, we can provide static outbound IPs from Dedicated pools. If they need VPN/IPsec peering we need network owner approval + config. Quick gist of allowed ranges:
```
203.0.113.10/32
203.0.113.11/32
203.0.113.20/29  # burst pool
```
sara_legal: They've asked for the DPA + security questionnaire answers. We have SOC2 report on file but need approval to send redacted artifacts. Also they asked about data residency for EU customers.
cory_cro: Who's owning exec outreach? We should loop in Elena to offer a short exec call with their CISO.
elena_vp_sales: I can take the call tomorrow 11am PT. Need bullet points: 1) SSO timeline, 2) IP/peering options, 3) DPA delivery date, 4) short-term workaround (customer router NAT + allowlist).
maria_sales: I'll send meeting invite and include their CISO + our infra lead. Also asking for pricing — they want a committed Dedicated quote vs hosted OPEX line to compare. Finance needs numbers.
julian_se: For a fast unblock, propose: (A) enable IdP-initiated SAML flag (3 days), (B) provide static egress IPs from Dedicated (same day if we use existing pool), (C) send redacted SOC2 + DPA draft (legal to confirm). If they still need IPsec we'll scope with infra.
sara_legal: DPA draft ready, will send redacted SOC2 in EOD. We need Sales to approve NDA send.
noah_infra: If they request IPsec peering, we'll need ASN, VLAN tag preference, and a contact for ticket. Also note throughput expectations — 1-5Gbps baseline.
maria_sales: Action items: Julian -> config change for IdP-initiated SAML; Noah -> confirm static IPs & peering steps; Sara -> share DPA + SOC2; Elena -> exec call tomorrow 11am PT. Cory -> approve committed quote template.
elena_vp_sales: Confirmed. Cory, can you prep an indicative Dedicated pricing for 6/12/24 month commits? Keep it conservative.
cory_cro: Will do. I'll post numbers before the call.
escalation_bot: Escalation created: ESC-2026-894. Linked to ticket infra/1023 and legal/223.
maria_sales: Great — I'll DM the customer to hold their internal go/no-go until after our call. Please post any blocking constraints here. :thumbsup:
elena_vp_sales: Also flagging potential risk: if they require on-prem air-gapped deploy we'll need a separate private deployment timeline (4-6 weeks). Call note.
julian_se: Noted — will prepare checklist and a quick demo of IdP flow for call.
noah_infra: I'll attach the network diagram to the meeting invite.
sara_legal: Sending DPA + redacted SOC2 to Julian + Maria in thread. :email:
maria_sales: Thanks — moving to prep. I'll update thread after call. End.
